mapper.insert: insert into blood_pressure (bp_id, member_no, record_date, bp_level, bp_high, bp_low) values (#{bp_id},#{member_no},#{record_date},#{bp_level},#{bp_high},#{bp_low})
mapper.select: select nvl(count(*),0) from blood_pressure where ${searchKey} like '%' || #{searchValue} || '%'

select * from ( select rownum rnum, data.* from( select bp_id, member_no, record_date, bp_level, bp_high, bp_low from blood_pressure where ${searchKey} like '%' || #{searchValue} || '%' order by bp_id desc) data)
where rnum>=#{start} and rnum<=#{end}
